items.evidence: leverage play <runs>/night-engine-1 --ticks 1 --settings k0 printed screen title and one JSON object with every key of the brief (tick, screen, menu_index, volume, difficulty, texts, cursor, piece, stock, grid, slot, slots, clock, speed, coins, served, lost, queue, customers, arrivals, replaying, replay_ready, ledger).
play --frame ... --size 800x480 wrote 9 PNGs (layout, night, title, settings, ledger, paused, summary, replay, README's rout.png); PNG signatures checked and every header reads 800 x 480.
checks run: 0:up -> menu_index 0, texts [Night Market, Layout, Ledger, Settings, Quit], replay_ready false; down x6 -> menu_index 3; down then up x3 -> 0.

Settings opens as [Settings, Volume: 5, Difficulty: Normal, Back]; right x7 -> volume 10 (Volume: 10); left x7 -> 0; difficulty left x3 -> easy (Difficulty: Easy), right x3 -> hard (Difficulty: Hard); escape -> title.
checks sharing settings p: run 1 set volume 7 / easy; run 2 (ticks 1) starts with volume 7, difficulty easy; a fresh settings name starts 5 / normal.
0:enter ticks 2: screen layout, cursor (0,0), piece stove, slot 1, stock 3/4/2, grid [], texts Layout, Piece: Stove, Slot: 1, Stove: 3, Table: 4, Lamp: 2, Enter/Escape lines.
play --at: up x6 -> y 1..4 then stays 4; right x9 -> x 7 stays; down x6 -> y 0 stays; left x9 -> x 0 stays; screen layout and menu_index 0 throughout.
next_piece x3: table, lamp, stove; prev_piece x3: lamp, table, stove; texts Piece: Table / Lamp / Stove follow.
place -> grid [stove 0,0], stock stove 2; 4th stove, 5th table, 3rd lamp leave grid at 3/4/2 pieces with stock 0; table placed on a stove cell changes nothing.
place then erase -> grid [], stove 3 (Stove: 3); same for a table (Table: 4); erase on an empty cell leaves grid [stove 0,0] and Stove: 2.

settings g: layout with stove (0,0) and table (1,1), escape -> title, enter -> layout again with the same grid and cursor (0,0); a later run on g shows the same grid and stock 2/3/2; a fresh place shows grid [].

play --at: next_slot gives 2, 3, 1 (Slot: N text); save_slot copied grid to slot 1 and slot 2, grid unchanged; load_slot on empty slot 3 changed nothing; load_slot on slot 1 gave 1 stove, stove stock 2.
later runs on the same place showed slots [1 stove],[2 stoves],[] as saved; loading slot 1 there turned the 2-stove grid into [stove 0,0] with stock 2.

Enter on empty grid, stove only, table only: screen layout and texts has Needs a stove and a table; with stove and table: screen night, clock 0, speed slow, coins/served/lost 0, grid unchanged, texts has 18:00.

play --at: slow clock 0->1 at tick 29, 2 at 53 (24 ticks); fast from tick 61 with progress 7 -> clock 3 at 65, then every 6 ticks; stop: clock 5 from 81 to 150, screen night, Speed: Stop; slow again -> 6 at tick 159 (kept progress 15). Time and Speed texts follow.
seed 1 arrivals [5,12,18,23,...,356], gaps min 4 max 10, all under 360, identical at every --at tick of the night; seeds 2,3,4,9,10 give other lists; seed 9 twice gives the same.
tables (1,3),(1,4),(2,0): customer 1 -> (1,3), 2 -> (1,4), 3 -> (2,0); one table: 2,3,4 queued with x/y null; customer 5 arriving at 33 with 3 queued -> lost 1 at minute 33.
stove (0,0) table (1,0): cust 1 cooking at minute 5, eating at 25; table (2,0) not adjacent: cooking at 34, eating at 35.
pays at 35 (adjacent) / 45 (not adjacent): coins 8, served 1, table taken by next; with lamp (2,0) next to table (1,0): coins 12 for one served.

Hard, stove not next to table: at minute 35 cust 1 gone, coins 0, lost 2 (1 turned away + 1), cust 2 cooking at once; Easy: cust 2 cooking at 71 (wait 59), gone at 72, cust 3 cooking at 72; Normal: cust 2 leaves at 52. Whole-night coins/served/lost match my own model of the brief for 6 layouts/difficulties.
one table: cust 1 pays at minute 35 and cust 2 (queued) is seated and cooking at minute 35 on the stove idle since 25; model with the brief's order matches all nights.
at clock 360 screen summary, texts [Night over, Coins: 36, Served: 3, Lost: 49, Enter: title] equal state; 4 customers still in the stall at the end, not counted (model agrees); Enter -> title.
stove/table/lamp layout, seed 1: fast 36/3/49, slow (8650 ticks) 36/3/49, mix of fast/stop/slow/fast/stop 36/3/49.

escape -> paused, texts [Paused, Resume, Title], clock stands at 1 ticks 31-100; Resume and Escape both return to the night at the same clock; down+enter (Title) -> title, ledger unchanged; on a place with a kept night, giving up left the ledger and a later Replay gave the original 36/3/49.
empty place: Ledger texts [Ledger, No nights yet, Back]; after the night ledger [{36,3,49,normal}] and Ledger screen line Coins 36, served 3, lost 49, Normal, also in a later run.
after nights 2,3,4 (seeds 2,3,4, hard) ledger is [12/1/50, 12/1/45, 24/2/43]: the first night gone, newest first; give-up and two replays added nothing.
after the night title texts [Night Market, Layout, Replay, Ledger, Settings, Quit], replay_ready true, also in later runs on the same place.

Replay with seed 7, difficulty set to hard, grid changed: screen night, replaying true, text Replay, arrivals of the seed-1 night, summary Replay over Coins: 36 Served: 3 Lost: 49 like the night; ledger and kept night unchanged. Replay frame draws the night's grid (stove shown though the layout has none); see defects about the state's grid key.
after the night: erased the stove, saved and loaded a slot, set Hard; Replay still gave 36/3/49 with the night's arrivals.
two copies of one kept folder, seed 9, same ticks and script: outputs byte-identical (cmp); seed 10 on a third copy gave other arrivals [5,9,15,25,...] vs [5,15,21,31,...].

f_layout.png: 8x5 grid, stove red with dark inset at (0,0), table brown at (1,0), lamp yellow square at (2,0), blue cursor frame at (2,2), panel with Piece: Lamp, Slot: 2, Stove: 2, Table: 3, Lamp: 1, as the state said.

f_night.png at 18:40: grid and pieces, 3 grey queued squares at the left, eating (green) at (1,3), cooking (magenta) at (1,4), seated (orange) at (2,0) as in the state; Coins, Served, Lost, 18:40, Speed: Fast shown.

title (> Ledger), settings (> Difficulty: Normal), ledger (3 lines, > Back), paused (> Title), summary (Night over, coins/served/lost, Enter: title) frames show their texts with the chosen entry marked.

README gives keys, the --settings folder and its settings.json as where everything is kept, and play / frame commands; both commands as written (path to work) ran: summary 36/3/49 and an 800x480 rout.png.

defects: The input word none does not clear Needs a stove and a table, although the brief says the words stay until the next word is given in Layout (any other word clears them).
During a replay the state's grid key shows the player's current layout, not the grid being replayed (the frame and the result use the kept night's grid).
Ledger lines are wider than the menu panel in the frame (Hard sticks out past its right edge).
Every frame shows the engine's own Pause button at the top left, which the game does not use.
